dbToolScopingDenylist.segment_contacts: Join table scoped indirectly via segment_id -> segments.owner_email; no direct owner column of its own.
dbToolScopingDenylist.contacts: Workspace-wide shared contact pool synced from HubSpot/CommonRoom -- every xDR/AE on the team works from the same contacts, not a per-user or per-org private set. No owner_email/org_id column by design; confirmed no action filters contacts queries by user or org anywhere in this app.
dbToolScopingDenylist.contact_sub_personas: Join table to contacts, which is itself workspace-wide shared data (see the contacts entry above) -- not owner/org-scoped at all, directly or indirectly.
dbToolScopingDenylist.persona_documents: Vestigial as of the shared-personas migration (see server/db/schema.ts) -- no longer read/written by any action, kept only for historical persona_id references.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics_events: Has a user_email column (not owner_email) that already scopes every row to the user who triggered the event -- naming convention mismatch, not an unscoped table.
dbToolScopingDenylist.prospect_pull_plan_runs: Scoped indirectly via plan_id -> prospect_pull_plans.owner_email; no direct owner column of its own.
